To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the internal statements are used for making consolidated financial statements of a business group.

(1) the consolidation of financial statements is the process of combining financial statements from individual companies into a single set of financial statements for the group of companies as a whole; (2) the process of consolidation is based on a general scheme of consolidation adjustments; (3) the consolidation adjustments of financial investments and internal operations of the group of companies are made on the basis of internal statements; (4) the consolidation adjustments for the goodwill and exchange rate difference are made on the balance sheet of the group
The emergence of the internal statements is the result from integration processes in the business that lead to pooling different companies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of the internal statements as a means to improve the quality of consolidated financial statements of a group of companies.
the analysis of financial statements of the parent companies and their subsidiaries in order to make consolidated financial statements.
the development of a methodology for the formation of internal financial statements of the group of companies in the process of consolidation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the internal statements are the key source of information in the consolidated financial statements.
the use of internal financial statements is an essential tool to consolidate the financial statements of the group of companies.
the consolidation process of financial statements is an important tool for the management of the business and its financial position.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the internal statements are the basis for consolidation of financial statements in order to make the information about internal operations, financial investments and goodwill.
it is important to understand the difference between the two statements and how they are used to analyze the financial health of a business.
the consolidation of financial statements requires the use of internal statements of the parent company and its subsidiaries.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the consolidation of financial statements is a complex and time consuming process.
internal statements are an important tool for the consolidation of financial statements.
internal financial statements are an effective tool for the consolidation of financial statements.
